title: Public Official Election Act, Article 82-8 (election campaigning using deepfake videos)
summary: Amendment to the Public Official Election Act added in December 2023 and in effect since 29 January 2024. From 90 days before an election until election day, no one may make, edit, distribute, screen or post AI-generated sounds, images or videos that are hard to tell from reality for campaign purposes, whatever their truth, consent or labelling. Outside that window, such content must be labelled as virtual under National Election Commission rules. The National Election Commission monitors and requests removal of such content. Open Net Korea filed a constitutional complaint against the ban on 1 October 2025.
key_obligations: No deepfake campaign content from 90 days before election day
Label deepfake campaign content as virtual outside the 90-day window
Ban penalty: up to 7 years' prison or KRW 10–50 million fine
Failure to label: administrative fine up to KRW 10 million
